platformFaq.networkQuestion: How does the referral network work?
platformFaq.networkAnswer: Your tree follows who invited whom. It shows your direct referrals and their connections across up to 15 levels. An invitation alone does not create a commission; payouts require a confirmed qualifying purchase.
platformFaq.walletQuestion: Do I need a crypto wallet to get started?
platformFaq.walletAnswer: Connect MetaMask, Rabby or Phantom and sign a message to create an account or sign in. Your wallet approves each purchase and transfer. Signing in does not send a transaction or cost gas.
platformFaq.embeddedAnswer: Choose a password; your member ID and encrypted EVM wallet are created automatically.
platformFaq.commissionsQuestion: How do the 15 referral levels work?
platformFaq.commissionsAnswer: Binary matrix pays 10%, 20%, 50% at depths 1?3. Unilevel pays 1% at fifteen binary placement depths. Missing or locked shares go to the platform.
platformFaq.testnetQuestion: Can I deposit or withdraw real USDT?
platformFaq.testnetAnswer: The current network is Polygon Amoy testnet. Purchases and transfers use test tokens, which have no monetary value. Test POL is required for network gas. Do not send real funds to testnet addresses.

referral.roundingHint: The first three uplines receive both shares. Amounts are rounded to six decimals so the total stays exact. Commissions credit the internal ledger; platform amounts await external settlement.
referral.latestDistribution: Latest purchase: {amount} USDT · {commissions} USDT credited to uplines · {platform} USDT payable to the platform address.
referral.insufficientCredits: Your available USDT credit balance is too low for this referral purchase.
referral.invalidLevel: Choose a referral level between 1 and 15.
referral.levelOrder: Purchase the next referral level in order. The maximum is level 15.
referral.feeRequired: Referral purchases are unavailable until an administrator sets the platform fee address.

dashboard.directHint: Members connected to your sponsor code
dashboard.loadFailed: Your account activity could not be loaded. Please refresh to try again.

onchain.networkHint: Polygon Amoy testnet · payments are on-chain.
onchain.unlockHint: Buy level 1 for 10 USDT from your Amoy wallet. The smart contract distributes the purchase automatically.
onchain.fundingHint: Your Amoy wallet needs the configured payment token and POL for gas.
onchain.tokenRequired: You need {required} {symbol} to buy this level. Your balance is {available} {symbol}.
onchain.gasRequired: You need at least {required} POL for the maximum gas budget. Your balance is {available} POL. Add Amoy test POL and refresh.
onchain.gasUnavailable: Refresh blockchain status to load the POL gas requirement.
onchain.pausedOrUnavailable: Purchases are paused or the blockchain is temporarily unavailable.
onchain.notConfigured: Smart-contract purchases are unavailable. Ask the administrator to check the Amoy contract, token and RPC configuration.
onchain.pendingHint: The system will recover this purchase automatically. Do not pay again. You can close this page.
onchain.revertedHint: No referral payment was distributed. Network gas may still have been charged.
onchain.refreshFailed: Blockchain status could not be refreshed. Try again shortly.
onchain.purchaseFailed: The blockchain purchase could not be submitted. Check its status before trying again.
onchain.confirmedNotice: Your purchase is confirmed and the smart contract has distributed the funds.
onchain.confirmHint: Pay from your account’s encrypted Amoy wallet. Your password authorizes this purchase and the required token approval.
onchain.approvalNotice: The token approval covers this purchase price. POL gas is charged separately. The full referral payment is distributed in one contract transaction.
onchain.distributionHint: Unilevel pays 1% at each of 15 placement depths. Missing or locked shares go to the platform.
onchain.adminHint: Confirmed token distributions on Polygon Amoy. Fee changes require the contract owner’s wallet.
onchain.ownerRequired: This administrator’s wallet does not own the contract. The owner must submit fee-address changes.
onchain.feeGasNotice: This authorizes a contract fee-address change with a maximum gas budget of {amount} POL. Previous distributions are unchanged.
onchain.feePending: The fee-address transaction is waiting for confirmation.
onchain.feeUpdated: The platform fee address has been updated on-chain.
onchain.insufficientToken: Your on-chain USDT balance is too low for this purchase.
onchain.insufficientGas: Add POL to your Amoy wallet to cover transaction gas.
onchain.gasChanged: Gas prices changed. Refresh the gas estimate and confirm again.
onchain.invalidGas: Refresh the gas estimate before confirming this transaction.
onchain.unavailable: The blockchain request could not be completed. Check purchase status before trying again.
onchain.configuredRequired: The referral smart contract is not configured yet.
onchain.pausedError: Referral smart contract purchases are paused.
onchain.useContract: Use the smart contract purchase flow to pay from your Amoy wallet.
onchain.pendingPurchaseError: Wait for your pending blockchain purchase to finish.
onchain.pendingTransactionError: Wait for your pending blockchain transaction to finish.
onchain.walletBusy: A wallet operation is already being prepared. Please try again.
onchain.ownerError: Your admin wallet must own the referral contract to change its fee address.
onchain.useFeeControl: Use the smart contract fee address control to update the on-chain recipient.

matrix.treeHint: Two branches per slot, three descendant rows (four rows including you). A full paid matrix opens another slot and queues the next level.
matrix.unilevelHint: Continuous binary placement, up to 15 steps. Extra invitations spill into the first available position below your referrals.
matrix.autoApproval: Enable automatic upgrades: approve up to {amount} {symbol} for this and remaining levels.
matrix.approvalHint: Only this purchase is charged now. When a paid matrix fills, the next-level price is deducted from your wallet using its token approval. You can revoke approval in your wallet. Insufficient funds or approval keeps the upgrade queued.
matrix.upgradeQueued: Automatic upgrade to level {level} is queued.
matrix.upgradeWaiting: Waiting for funds, token approval or the upgrade service.
